channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: 'It Starts With Coaches'; Should Kris Knoblauch's Job As The Oilers' Coach Be In Jeopardy?
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers headed into the Olympic Break on a losing skid, and star center Leon Draisaitl's pointed comments about the team needing improvement include coach Kris Knoblauch. If the Oilers don't turn things around soon, will Knoblauch's job security be jeopardized?

item.title: Hey, New York Rangers, Here's Your Future
item.description: Following the blockbuster Artemi Panarin trade, Liam Greentree has become one of the most important players within the New York Rangers organization, as he headlines a new future.

item.title: Countries With NHL Players Who Won't Be Playing In The 2026 Olympics
item.description: The 2026 Olympics will feature over 100 NHL players, but many stars won't attend because their countries have been banned or didn't qualify.

item.title: 'John Will Be Right There'; Gaudreau Family Pens Touching Letter As Team USA Prepares For The Olympics
item.description: Team USA is chasing Olympic gold at the 2026 Games, and they have a profound, bittersweet motivation: honoring the lives of the late Johnny Gaudreau and his brother, Matthew.

item.title: What Could The Maple Leafs Do To Justify Trading Away Fraser Minten?
item.description: Boston Bruins rookie Fraser Minten is shining this season, while the player he was traded for – veteran defenseman Brandon Carlo – hasn't found his stride in Toronto. How can Leafs GM Brad Treliving salvage this lopsided trade?

item.title: Team Canada Selects Sidney Crosby As Captain At The Olympics For The Second Time
item.description: Sidney Crosby will captain Team Canada at the 2026 Winter Olympics, joined by Connor McDavid and Cale Makar as alternate captains.

item.title: NHL Teams With The Most Representation At The 2026 Olympics
item.description: All 32 NHL teams will send at least one representative to the 2026 Olympics, but which teams will send the most players?

item.title: Auston Matthews Selected As Captain For Team USA At 2026 Olympics
item.description: Auston Matthews will captain Team USA at the 2026 Winter Olympics, joined by Charlie McAvoy and Matthew Tkachuk as alternate captains.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Why Team USA Is My Pick For Gold Over Canada
item.description: Many people are picking Canada to win a gold medal in the 2026 Olympics men's hockey tournament. However, Team USA is clearly a co-favorite and could win to nobody's surprise.

item.title: What The 2026 NHL All-Star Rosters Would Have Looked Like
item.description: The NHL hasn't had an All-Star Game since 2024, and won't run the event until 2027, but today, we look at what the rosters could have looked like if the NHL did host an All-Star Game.
